title: X0 Bot: Half-peek, upside down
subtitle: The black box head hangs into a white tile from the top edge and looks down at you, with wide curious eyes (one a touch bigger). There are five flat takes, plus soft-matte renders of the best two. Ranked, strongest first. The dashed card is the Grok Bot icon, for comparison only.

soft-sideways.title: Side glance, soft
soft-sideways.line: Rendered: a matte black head, satin white eyes, glossy pupils with a catchlight, and one brow tick up. The most curious and the most alive.

soft-drop.title: Looking down, soft
soft-drop.line: Rendered: both eyes look straight down at you. Calmer and the most direct: 'I see you'.

flat-3-sideways.title: Side glance, flat
flat-3-sideways.line: Pupils down and to the side, the bigger eye's brow raised. The best flat take.

flat-1-drop.title: Looking down, flat
flat-1-drop.line: Flipped: the eyes sit right by the rim, so the head clearly peeks over the edge.

flat-4-tilt.title: Tilted
flat-4-tilt.line: The head cocked as it hangs. Livelier, but the crop goes lopsided and reads less clean.

flat-2-upright.title: Upright, hanging
flat-2-upright.line: Right way up with chin below the eyes. Same silhouette (a box head is symmetric), but the eyes sit high, so it hangs rather than peeks.

flat-5-antenna.title: Antenna down
flat-5-antenna.line: A stub of antenna points down from the crown to say 'upside down'. It reads as a drip or lollipop stick. Dropped.

reference.title: Grok Bot (reference)
reference.line: Not ours: shown for level and distinctness.
